Details 
 Nothing quite compares to the classic Western look of the King of Country. With a straight-forward style that's both casual and comfortable, the Wrangler® George Strait button-down shirt provides the perfect opportunity for you to put your own spin on the look of a legend. Every mens George Strait plaid button-down shirt features a button-down collar, single front pocket with our logo embroidery, adjustable cuffs, and a straight back yoke with pleating for a touch of Western appeal. Our mens plaid button-down shirt comes in a wide variety of colorful patterns and sizes. You're going to love the way it wears just as much as how it looks.
